summary.description: Skill map, mental model, dan cara berpikir database architect yang production-grade: dari workload, invariant, storage, transaksi, hingga operasi.

parts.title: Learn Database Design and Architect - Part 001
parts.description: Skill map, mental model, dan cara berpikir database architect yang production-grade: dari workload, invariant, storage, transaksi, hingga operasi.

parts.title: Learn Database Design and Architect - Part 002
parts.description: Database sebagai system of truth: authority, ownership, source of record, derived data, write authority, consistency boundary, dan failure mode saat kebenaran data terpecah.

parts.title: Learn Database Design and Architect - Part 003
parts.description: Deep dive into data lifecycle and state thinking for production-grade database design, including lifecycle stages, mutability, history, transitions, correction, deletion, archival, and state defensibility.

parts.title: Learn Database Design and Architect - Part 004
parts.description: Production-grade workload-first database design, covering OLTP, OLAP, HTAP, query shapes, write paths, access patterns, consistency, latency, throughput, contention, and architectural tradeoffs.

parts.title: Learn Database Design and Architect - Part 005
parts.description: Turning business requirements, workflows, policies, and operational constraints into a defensible data model that can survive real production use.

parts.title: Learn Database Design and Architect - Part 006
parts.description: Designing entity boundaries, aggregate ownership, lifecycle responsibility, and cross-domain references so a database model remains coherent as the system grows.

parts.title: Learn Database Design and Architect - Part 007
parts.description: Conceptual, logical, and physical modelling as a disciplined bridge from business meaning to executable database design.

parts.title: Learn Database Design and Architect - Part 008
parts.description: A practical method for designing schemas from invariants, illegal states, constraints, transitions, and enforcement boundaries.

parts.title: Learn Database Design and Architect - Part 009
parts.description: Deep dive into the relational model as a precision tool for modelling facts, predicates, constraints, relationships, keys, and queryable truth in production database architecture.

parts.title: Learn Database Design and Architect - Part 010
parts.description: A production-grade explanation of database normalization, functional dependencies, normal forms, update anomalies, lossless decomposition, and disciplined tradeoffs for real software systems.

parts.title: Learn Database Design Architect Part 011 Denormalization With Discipline
Learn Database Design Architect Part 012 Keys Identity And Reference Design
Learn Database Design and Architect - Part 013
parts.description: Deep dive into cardinality, optionality, relationship modelling, association tables, relationship-as-entity design, and production-grade relationship constraints.

parts.title: Learn Database Design and Architect - Part 014
parts.description: Deep dive into temporal database design, effective time, transaction time, bitemporal modelling, timestamp types, intervals, timezone strategy, and temporal invariants.

parts.title: Learn Database Design and Architect - Part 015
parts.description: Mendesain audit, history, dan regulatory traceability sebagai first-class database capability, bukan sekadar kolom created_at/updated_at.

parts.title: Learn Database Design and Architect - Part 016
parts.description: Mendesain soft delete, archival, purge, legal hold, dan retention policy secara aman untuk sistem produksi dan regulatory-grade workloads.

parts.title: Learn Database Design and Architect - Part 017
parts.description: Mendesain schema database untuk state machine, transition, guard, transition history, dan pencegahan illegal state pada sistem produksi.

parts.title: Learn Database Design and Architect - Part 018
parts.description: Mendesain database untuk workflow dan case management: case, task, assignment, escalation, SLA, decision, evidence, audit, queue, dan reporting.

parts.title: Learn Database Design and Architect - Part 019
parts.description: Mendesain database multi-tenant production-grade: isolation model, tenant-scoped schema, pooled/silo/hybrid topology, migration, backup, noisy neighbor, observability, dan tenant lifecycle.

parts.title: Learn Database Design and Architect - Part 020
parts.description: Mendesain security boundary di level schema: ownership, tenant boundary, access scope, ACL, membership, row-level policy, least privilege, sensitive columns, audit, support access, dan policy testing.

parts.title: Learn Database Design and Architect - Part 021
parts.description: Memahami database dari sisi physical storage: page, block, heap, row layout, tuple version, buffer pool, WAL boundary, bloat, vacuum, row-store vs column-store, dan implikasi desain schema terhadap performa serta operabilitas.

parts.title: Learn Database Design and Architect - Part 022
parts.description: Memahami B-Tree/B+Tree dan index internals: root/internal/leaf pages, search path, range scan, page split, composite index, covering index, partial/expression index, write amplification, bloat, dan strategi index untuk workload produksi.

parts.title: Learn Database Design and Architect - Part 023
parts.description: Production-grade index design from workload, query shape, cardinality, selectivity, ordering, uniqueness, write amplification, and operational governance.

parts.title: Learn Database Design and Architect - Part 024
parts.description: Deep dive into query planner mental model, statistics, cardinality estimation, cost model, access paths, join strategies, and production query plan diagnosis.

parts.title: Learn Database Design and Architect - Part 025
parts.description: Membaca execution plan secara sistematis untuk mendiagnosis scan, join, sort, aggregate, estimasi cardinality, memory pressure, dan query latency di production.

parts.title: Learn Database Design and Architect - Part 026
parts.description: Mendesain bentuk SQL query yang selaras dengan index, planner, concurrency, pagination, aggregation, join, dan production latency.

parts.title: Learn Database Design and Architect - Part 027
parts.description: Deep dive transaction model untuk database design: ACID, transaction boundary, invariant, WAL, retry, idempotency, dan desain transaksi yang aman di sistem produksi.

parts.title: Learn Database Design and Architect - Part 028
parts.description: Deep dive isolation levels dan concurrency anomalies: dirty read, non-repeatable read, phantom, lost update, write skew, read skew, serializable, dan cara memilih isolation untuk workload produksi.

parts.title: Learn Database Design and Architect - Part 029
parts.description: Deep dive into MVCC, locking, contention, deadlocks, hot rows, and production diagnosis for database systems.

parts.title: Learn Database Design and Architect - Part 030
parts.description: Production-grade concurrency control patterns for SQL-backed systems, including optimistic locking, pessimistic locking, guarded writes, idempotency, queues, retries, and invariant-safe transaction design.

parts.title: Learn Database Design and Architect - Part 031
parts.description: Durability, write-ahead logging, checkpoints, fsync, crash recovery, and the real contract behind a committed database transaction.

parts.title: Learn Database Design and Architect - Part 032
parts.description: Backup, restore, RPO, RTO, point-in-time recovery, restore drills, blast-radius control, and the operational discipline behind recoverable databases.

parts.title: Learn Database Design and Architect - Part 033
parts.description: Replication models for production databases, including leader-follower replication, synchronous and asynchronous commit, logical and physical replication, replication lag, failover, split-brain prevention, topology choices, and operational review checklists.

parts.title: Learn Database Design and Architect - Part 034
parts.description: Read scaling with replicas, stale reads, read-your-writes, session consistency, lag-aware routing, query classification, primary fallback, freshness contracts, and production failure modes.

parts.title: Learn Database Design and Architect - Part 035
parts.description: Partitioning and sharding from production architecture perspective: partition key, shard key, pruning, routing, rebalancing, hotspots, tenant distribution, and operational failure modes.

parts.title: Learn Database Design and Architect - Part 036
parts.description: Distributed transactions and sagas in production systems: local transactions, 2PC, outbox, compensation, idempotency, orchestration, choreography, consistency boundaries, and failure modelling.

parts.title: Learn Database Design and Architect - Part 037
parts.description: CAP, PACELC, and real tradeoffs for designing distributed database systems, including consistency, availability, latency, partition behavior, and business impact.

parts.title: Learn Database Design and Architect - Part 038
parts.description: Distributed SQL architecture explained through ranges, consensus, replication, transaction routing, locality, schema design, and operational tradeoffs.

parts.title: Learn Database Design and Architect - Part 039
parts.description: Key-value and LSM database design explained from storage internals, key design, access patterns, compaction, amplification, consistency, and production failure modes.

parts.title: Learn Database Design and Architect - Part 040
parts.description: Document database design explained through aggregate boundaries, embedding versus referencing, schema discipline, indexing, consistency, migrations, and production failure modes.

parts.title: Learn Database Design and Architect - Part 041
parts.description: Wide-column database design for production systems: partition key, clustering key, query-driven schema, denormalization, tombstone, hotspot, consistency, and operational failure modes.

parts.title: Learn Database Design and Architect - Part 042
parts.description: Graph database design for production systems: property graph mental model, node and relationship modelling, traversal, indexes, path explosion, relational boundary, authorization, versioning, and failure modes.

parts.title: Learn Database Design and Architect - Part 043
parts.description: Search and vector index-aware design for production systems: inverted index, full-text search, semantic retrieval, hybrid search, filtered vector search, freshness, security, rebuild, and operational failure modes.

parts.title: Learn Database Design and Architect - Part 044
parts.description: A production-grade framework for choosing the right database engine based on workload, invariants, query shape, scale, consistency, operations, security, migration risk, and organizational capability.

parts.title: Learn Database Design and Architect - Part 045
parts.description: Polyglot persistence with discipline: how to use multiple database engines without turning architecture into inconsistent, ungoverned operational debt.

parts.title: Learn Database Design and Architect - Part 046
parts.description: Application-database boundary design: how to structure data access, transaction boundaries, SQL ownership, ORM usage, repositories, and failure handling without hiding database reality.

parts.title: Learn Database Design and Architect - Part 047
parts.description: Schema evolution and migration for production-grade database systems: compatibility, expand-contract, versioned contracts, online backfill, data correction, governance, testing, and rollback.

parts.title: Learn Database Design and Architect - Part 048
parts.description: Zero-downtime database changes in production: safe DDL, compatibility rollout, online backfill, dual write, cutover, validation, rollback, incident handling, and operational playbooks.

parts.title: Learn Database Design and Architect - Part 049
parts.description: Data contracts at the database boundary: compatibility, consumer impact, contract surfaces, schema governance, migration safety, and production-grade change control.

parts.title: Learn Database Design and Architect - Part 050
parts.description: CDC and event-driven database integration: change data capture, outbox, ordering, replay, idempotency, snapshots, schema evolution, and exactly-once illusion.

parts.title: Learn Database Design and Architect - Part 051
parts.description: Idempotency and deduplication design for retry-safe database write paths, event consumers, outbox/inbox pipelines, command tables, and production-grade duplicate prevention.

parts.title: Learn Database Design and Architect - Part 052
parts.description: Data quality and constraint strategy for production databases: invariant taxonomy, database constraints, validation layers, quality gates, quarantine, repair, observability, and governance.

parts.title: Learn Database Design and Architect - Part 053
parts.description: Observability for database systems: metrics, logs, traces, query identity, wait events, locks, replication lag, autovacuum, slow queries, dashboards, alerts, and incident diagnosis.

parts.title: Learn Database Design and Architect - Part 054
parts.description: Database performance engineering as a disciplined production process: workload baselines, bottleneck isolation, query/index/schema tuning, resource tuning, concurrency, autovacuum, capacity envelope, and regression prevention.

parts.title: Learn Database Design and Architect - Part 055
parts.description: Production-grade database load testing and benchmarking: workload contracts, realistic data generation, concurrency ramp, saturation analysis, pgbench/custom scripts, read/write mixes, tail latency, bottleneck diagnosis, and benchmark reporting.

parts.title: Learn Database Design and Architect - Part 056
parts.description: Capacity planning and growth modelling for production databases: demand model, storage growth, index amplification, WAL, memory, CPU, I/O, connections, tenant skew, retention, headroom, scaling triggers, forecasting, and cost-aware architecture decisions.

parts.title: Learn Database Design and Architect - Part 057
parts.description: Production-grade treatment of hotspots, skew, and high-cardinality data: how bottlenecks emerge, how to detect them from database signals, and how to redesign keys, indexes, partitions, queues, counters, tenants, and observability dimensions before they become incidents.

parts.title: Learn Database Design and Architect - Part 058
parts.description: Operational runbooks for production database incidents: triage, diagnosis, mitigation, escalation, evidence capture, and durable fixes for slow queries, lock storms, connection exhaustion, disk/WAL pressure, replication lag, bloat, bad migrations, noisy tenants, CDC failure, backup/restore failure, and data correctness incidents.

parts.title: Learn Database Design and Architect - Part 059
parts.description: Failure-mode and risk modelling for production-grade database architecture: failure taxonomy, blast radius, FMEA, fault trees, controls, degraded modes, and risk review method.

parts.title: Learn Database Design and Architect - Part 060
parts.description: Production-grade database security architecture: threat model, roles, privileges, network boundaries, encryption, secrets, audit, RLS, backups, CDC, admin access, and security review checklists.

parts.title: Learn Database Design and Architect - Part 061
parts.description: Row-level security dan data access control sebagai enforcement layer di database: policy model, tenant isolation, ABAC-style filtering, write protection, ownership, testing, observability, dan failure modes.
parts.partTitle: Row-Level Security and Data Access Control

parts.title: Learn Database Design and Architect - Part 062
parts.description: Privacy, retention, and compliance design untuk database architecture: PII inventory, minimization, purpose limitation, masking, retention policy, legal hold, erasure, auditability, analytics boundary, dan operational proof.

parts.title: Learn Database Design and Architect - Part 063
parts.description: Data lineage dan provenance untuk database architecture: origin, transformation, dependency graph, evidence-grade traceability, impact analysis, reconstruction, governance, dan operational proof.

parts.title: Learn Database Design and Architect - Part 064
parts.description: Master data, reference data, dan taxonomy untuk database architecture: trusted entities, reference lifecycle, hierarchy, versioning, stewardship, synchronization, mapping, and governance.
parts.partTitle: Master Data, Reference Data, and Taxonomy

parts.title: Learn Database Design and Architect - Part 065
parts.description: Analytical modelling dan dimensional design untuk warehouse/reporting: grain, fact, dimension, star schema, SCD, snapshots, bridge tables, conformed dimensions, dan correctness contract.

parts.title: Learn Database Design and Architect - Part 066
parts.description: Operational vs analytical data boundaries: OLTP, OLAP, reporting correctness, workload isolation, freshness, reconciliation, semantic layer, CDC/ETL, and ownership.

parts.title: Learn Database Design and Architect - Part 067
parts.description: Data lakehouse and warehouse architecture for production-grade analytical platforms: lake, warehouse, lakehouse, bronze/silver/gold, table formats, governance, lineage, freshness, cost, and operational failure modes.

parts.title: Learn Database Design and Architect - Part 068
parts.description: Query serving patterns for production database architecture: CQRS read models, materialized views, aggregate tables, projections, search indexes, cache-backed reads, freshness contracts, rebuildability, and consistency tradeoffs.

parts.title: Learn Database Design and Architect - Part 069
parts.description: Large-scale reporting design untuk sistem database production-grade: snapshot report, reproducible report, async report, export pipeline, freshness contract, authorization, reconciliation, dan failure modes.

parts.title: Learn Database Design and Architect - Part 070
parts.description: Metode review arsitektur database production-grade: review scope, evidence, invariants, workload, consistency, operations, security, failure modes, decision record, dan risk scoring.

parts.title: Learn Database Design and Architect - Part 071
parts.description: Template database design document production-grade ala internal engineering handbook: context, authority, invariants, workload, schema, transactions, migration, security, observability, DR, failure modes, dan review evidence.

parts.title: Learn Database Design and Architect - Part 072
parts.description: Checklist review schema database production-grade: semantic grain, key, constraint, index, transaction, migration, tenant isolation, security, privacy, observability, failure modes, dan SQL diagnosis snippets.

parts.title: Learn Database Design and Architect - Part 073
parts.description: Production readiness checklist untuk database production-grade: ownership, schema, transaction, migration, backup, restore, observability, security, privacy, capacity, failure mode, dan operational runbook.

parts.title: Learn Database Design and Architect - Part 074
parts.description: Case study database design untuk regulatory case management: case lifecycle, enforcement workflow, evidence, audit, SLA, escalation, access control, reporting, CDC, failure modes, dan production readiness.
parts.partTitle: Case Study Regulatory Case Management Database

parts.title: Learn Database Design and Architect - Part 075
parts.description: Case study production-grade untuk high-volume transaction ledger: double-entry thinking, immutable journal, balance projection, idempotency, reconciliation, concurrency, reporting, dan failure-mode modelling.

parts.title: Learn Database Design and Architect - Part 076
parts.description: Case study production-grade untuk multi-tenant SaaS platform: tenant isolation, data partitioning, lifecycle, catalog, RLS, noisy neighbor, tenant migration, reporting, backup/restore, dan operational governance.

parts.title: Learn Database Design and Architect - Part 077
parts.description: Case study production-grade untuk event-driven operational database: canonical write model, transactional outbox, CDC, projection, replay, ordering, idempotency, failure recovery, dan operational governance.

parts.title: Learn Database Design and Architect - Part 078
parts.description: Case study production-grade untuk distributed global application: region topology, data homing, consistency contract, failover, latency, data residency, conflict avoidance, global identifiers, and operational readiness.

parts.title: Learn Database Design and Architect - Part 079
parts.description: Catalog production-grade untuk common database design smells: gejala, akar masalah, dampak, cara diagnosis, contoh schema buruk, perbaikan, dan review checklist.

parts.title: Learn Database Design and Architect - Part 080
parts.description: Production-grade handbook untuk refactoring bad database design: strategy, expand-contract, strangler migration, compatibility layer, backfill, validation, cutover, rollback, data repair, and governance.

parts.title: Learn Database Design and Architect - Part 081
parts.description: Production-grade framework untuk memilih, menjustifikasi, dan mempertahankan keputusan arsitektur database berdasarkan authority, invariant, workload, consistency, scale, security, operasi, dan evolusi.

parts.title: Learn Database Design and Architect - Part 082
parts.description: Engineering leadership untuk menaikkan kualitas database design lintas tim: ownership, review culture, paved road, governance, migration discipline, incident learning, dan maturity model.

parts.title: Learn Database Design and Architect - Part 083
parts.description: Advanced database design interview and architecture review drills for practicing production-grade reasoning, tradeoff analysis, invariant modelling, workload analysis, and failure-mode review.
parts.partTitle: Database Design Interview and Review Drills

parts.title: Learn Database Design and Architect - Part 084
parts.description: Final synthesis and top 1% playbook for database design and architecture, covering mental models, operating principles, review discipline, production readiness, and long-term engineering mastery.

parts.description: Observability production-grade untuk PL/pgSQL: RAISE levels, NOTICE/DEBUG/WARNING, diagnostic context, logging discipline, correlation id, dan debug signals yang aman.

parts.title: Learn PL/pgSQL In Action - Part 013
parts.description: Assertion, contract, dan runtime guardrail untuk PL/pgSQL production-grade: kapan memakai ASSERT, kapan memakai RAISE, bagaimana merancang precondition, postcondition, invariant, dan kill-switch.

parts.partTitle: Dynamic SQL: EXECUTE, FORMAT, Quote Ident, and USING

parts.description: Plan caching, generic plans, custom plans, EXECUTE replanning, parameter-sensitive queries, dan jebakan performa PL/pgSQL di production.

parts.description: Event trigger untuk DDL guardrail, schema governance, migration safety, dan kontrol perubahan database di PostgreSQL production-grade.

parts.description: Transaction isolation, MVCC snapshots, retryable failures, serialization errors, deadlocks, dan consistency pattern untuk PL/pgSQL production routines.

parts.description: Idempotency, deduplication, replay safety, and exactly-once-ish database workflows using PL/pgSQL, PostgreSQL constraints, transactional outbox, and retry-aware design.

parts.partTitle: Arrays, Ranges, Enums, and Advanced PostgreSQL Types in PL/pgSQL

summary.description: Kaufman skill map untuk menguasai SQL secara efektif, dengan target skill produksi, operating model SQL, feedback loop, deliberate practice, dan mental model engineer-level.

parts.title: Learn SQL in Action - Part 001
parts.description: Kaufman skill map untuk menguasai SQL secara efektif, dengan target skill produksi, operating model SQL, feedback loop, deliberate practice, dan mental model engineer-level.
parts.partTitle: Kaufman Skill Map and SQL Operating Model

parts.title: Learn SQL in Action - Part 002
parts.description: Fondasi relational model untuk SQL production: relation, tuple, attribute, domain, predicate, key, set vs bag, NULL, three-valued logic, dan relational reasoning.

parts.title: Learn SQL in Action - Part 003
parts.description: Mental model database engine untuk memahami perjalanan SQL dari text menjadi result: parser, binder, rewriter, optimizer, executor, storage engine, buffer pool, WAL, lock manager, MVCC, dan catalog.

parts.title: Learn SQL in Action - Part 004
parts.description: SQL syntax sebagai intent deklaratif: SELECT, FROM, WHERE, GROUP BY, HAVING, ORDER BY, LIMIT/FETCH, logical processing order, alias scope, expression evaluation, dan bug semantic umum.

parts.title: Learn SQL in Action - Part 005
parts.description: Schema design as invariant engineering: tables, keys, constraints, defaults, identity, generated columns, referential integrity, naming, and production review discipline.
parts.partTitle: Schema Design: Tables, Keys, and Constraints

parts.title: Learn SQL in Action - Part 006
parts.description: Data types as domain contracts: numeric precision, temporal correctness, text/collation, boolean modelling, UUIDs, enums, domains, binary data, coercion, and production failure modes.
parts.partTitle: Data Types, Domains, and Precision Failure

parts.title: Learn SQL in Action - Part 007
parts.description: Semantik INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE, dan MERGE untuk sistem produksi: mutasi data, upsert, returning/output, write amplification, idempotency, optimistic update, lost update prevention, dan desain DML yang aman.
parts.partTitle: INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE, and MERGE Semantics

parts.title: Learn SQL in Action - Part 008
parts.description: Filtering, predicates, three-valued logic, NULL traps, IN/EXISTS, BETWEEN, LIKE, regex, sargability, implicit cast, dan desain predicate yang benar untuk sistem produksi.

parts.title: Learn SQL in Action - Part 009
parts.description: Join sebagai mekanisme menggabungkan fakta dan relationship secara benar, termasuk inner join, outer join, semi join, anti join, fan-out, null-extension, dan debugging cardinality.

parts.title: Learn SQL in Action - Part 010
parts.description: Aggregation, grouping, dan measure correctness untuk SQL produksi, termasuk COUNT variants, SUM/AVG, GROUP BY, HAVING, distinct aggregation, conditional aggregation, rollup, cube, grouping sets, dan metric traps.

parts.title: Learn SQL in Action - Part 011
parts.description: Subqueries, CTEs, and query composition for production SQL: scalar/table subqueries, correlated queries, derived tables, recursive CTEs, LATERAL/APPLY, materialization behavior, and composable query contracts.

parts.title: Learn SQL in Action - Part 012
parts.description: Production-grade window functions: partitioning, ordering, frames, ranking, running totals, latest-row selection, gaps-and-islands, sessionization, deduplication, audit timelines, and performance reasoning.

parts.title: Learn SQL in Action - Part 013
parts.description: Production-grade set operations and relational differencing: UNION, INTERSECT, EXCEPT, ALL vs DISTINCT, reconciliation, delta detection, data comparison, audit validation, and correctness traps.

parts.title: Learn SQL in Action - Part 014
parts.description: First-principles index literacy: B-tree, hash, bitmap, BRIN/zonemap, covering indexes, composite order, selectivity, clustering, write cost, and production index trade-offs.

parts.title: Learn SQL in Action - Part 015
parts.description: Practical index design through sargability, access paths, predicate shape, composite index order, covering indexes, partial indexes, expression indexes, and production workload reasoning.
parts.partTitle: Sargability, Access Paths, and Index Design

parts.title: Learn SQL in Action - Part 016
parts.description: Query plan literacy for production SQL: EXPLAIN, actual plans, scans, joins, sorts, aggregates, cost estimates, cardinality, plan debugging, and optimizer reasoning.
parts.partTitle: Query Plans, EXPLAIN, and Optimizer Literacy

parts.title: Learn SQL in Action - Part 017
parts.description: Cardinality, statistics, and cost model failures for production SQL: row estimates, histograms, skew, correlation, parameter-sensitive plans, stale stats, and practical remediation.
parts.partTitle: Cardinality, Statistics, and Cost Model Failures

parts.title: Learn SQL in Action - Part 018
parts.description: Transactions, ACID, and unit-of-work design for production SQL: transaction boundaries, commit/rollback, savepoints, idempotency, retries, invariants, and application/database consistency.

parts.title: Learn SQL in Action - Part 019
parts.description: Isolation levels, MVCC, locks, and concurrency anomalies for production SQL: visibility rules, lost updates, write skew, phantoms, serializability, and anomaly testing.
parts.partTitle: Isolation Levels, MVCC, Locking, and Anomalies

parts.title: Learn SQL in Action - Part 020
parts.description: Concurrency control, deadlocks, and contention in production SQL: lock waits, hot rows, queue patterns, SKIP LOCKED, advisory locks, retry loops, and throughput/correctness trade-offs.

parts.title: Learn SQL in Action - Part 021
parts.description: Normalization, denormalization, dependency theory, data shape, aggregate boundaries, read/write model trade-offs, and schema evolution cost for production relational systems.

parts.title: Learn SQL in Action - Part 022
parts.description: Modelling real business workflows in SQL: state machines, lifecycle tables, audit trails, approvals, escalation, temporal facts, events, and defensible case management data models.
parts.partTitle: Modelling Real Business Workflows in SQL

parts.title: Learn SQL in Action - Part 023
parts.description: Temporal SQL, history, and auditability: valid time, transaction time, bitemporal modelling, immutable history, audit trails, point-in-time reconstruction, and defensible data lineage.

parts.title: Learn SQL in Action - Part 024
parts.description: JSON, semi-structured data, and hybrid relational design: when to use JSON, how to index it, how to validate it, how to migrate out of blobs, and how to keep relational truth governable.
parts.partTitle: JSON, Semi-Structured, and Hybrid Relational Design

parts.title: Learn SQL in Action - Part 025
parts.description: Partitioning, sharding, and large table strategy: how to divide large relational data safely without confusing physical layout with logical modelling.
parts.partTitle: Partitioning, Sharding, and Large Table Strategy

parts.title: Learn SQL in Action - Part 026
parts.description: Views, materialized views, and derived truth: how to use query abstractions, persisted results, refresh strategies, and dependency boundaries without corrupting source-of-truth semantics.
parts.partTitle: Views, Materialized Views, and Derived Truth

parts.title: Learn SQL in Action - Part 027
parts.description: Stored procedures, functions, triggers, and database boundary design: when executable database logic protects invariants, when it damages operability, and how to design it deliberately.
parts.partTitle: Stored Procedures, Functions, and Database Boundaries

parts.title: Learn SQL in Action - Part 028
parts.description: Migrations, schema evolution, and backward compatibility: how to safely change relational databases under live traffic using expand-contract, backfills, validation, and release choreography.
parts.partTitle: Migrations, Schema Evolution, and Backward Compatibility

parts.title: Learn SQL in Action - Part 029
parts.description: Security, permissions, and data access control in SQL systems: roles, privileges, row-level security, column protection, tenant isolation, SQL injection prevention, auditability, and least-privilege review.
parts.partTitle: Security, Permissions, and Data Access Control

parts.title: Learn SQL in Action - Part 030
parts.description: Analytics SQL for engineering decisions: metric correctness, funnels, cohorts, retention, SLA/SLO analysis, latency percentiles, incident analysis, anomaly detection, and decision-grade query design.

parts.title: Learn SQL in Action - Part 031
parts.description: Data quality, testing, and SQL as an assertion language for production systems: invariant queries, reconciliation, duplicate detection, referential drift, data contract tests, freshness, sampling, and release gates.
parts.partTitle: Data Quality, Testing, and SQL as Assertion Language

parts.title: Learn SQL in Action - Part 032
parts.description: Observability, performance, and operational debugging for SQL systems: slow queries, wait events, locks, buffer/cache metrics, index bloat, vacuum/analyze, query regression, and production playbooks.

parts.title: Learn Sql In Action Part 033 Sql Across Engines Portability And Vendor Differences
Learn Sql In Action Part 034 System Design With Sql And Relational Databases
Learn Sql In Action Part 035 Capstone Sql In Action Production Casebook

summary.description: Skill map, mental model, target competence, and deliberate practice plan for mastering production-grade GitOps and Infrastructure-as-Code pipeline engineering.

parts.title: Learn State-of-the-Art GitOps/IaC Pipeline - Part 001
parts.description: Skill map, mental model, target competence, and deliberate practice plan for mastering production-grade GitOps and Infrastructure-as-Code pipeline engineering.

parts.title: Learn State-of-the-Art GitOps/IaC Pipeline - Part 002
parts.description: Why GitOps and IaC should be designed as an operating model instead of a pile of tools, with practical boundaries, state machines, control loops, and production-grade decision rules.
parts.partTitle: GitOps/IaC Is an Operating Model, Not a Toolchain

parts.title: Learn State-of-the-Art GitOps/IaC Pipeline - Part 003
parts.description: System boundaries, trust boundaries, ownership boundaries, and production invariants for designing a safe GitOps/IaC pipeline.

parts.title: Learn State-of-the-Art GitOps/IaC Pipeline - Part 004
parts.description: End-to-end reference architecture for a modern GitOps/IaC platform, from pull request to plan, policy, approval, apply, reconciliation, observability, and audit evidence.
parts.partTitle: Reference Architecture of a Modern GitOps/IaC Platform

parts.title: Learn State-of-the-Art GitOps/IaC Pipeline - Part 005
parts.description: Repository topology decision framework for applications, infrastructure, environments, policies, secrets references, and platform control planes in a production GitOps/IaC pipeline.
parts.partTitle: Repository Topologies for Apps, Infra, Environments, and Policies

parts.title: Learn State-of-the-Art GitOps/IaC Pipeline - Part 006
parts.description: Branching, promotion, approval, merge, apply, reconciliation, emergency changes, and rollback flow for production-grade GitOps/IaC platforms.

parts.title: Learn State-of-the-Art GitOps/IaC Pipeline - Part 007
parts.description: Decision framework for selecting Terraform, OpenTofu, Pulumi, Crossplane, cloud-native engines, and reconciliation patterns in a production-grade GitOps/IaC platform.
parts.partTitle: IaC Engine Selection: Terraform, OpenTofu, Pulumi, Crossplane

parts.title: Learn State-of-the-Art GitOps/IaC Pipeline - Part 008
parts.description: Deep dive into Terraform/OpenTofu state, backend design, locking, workspaces, state boundaries, drift, partial failure, state corruption, secrets, and recovery playbooks.
parts.partTitle: Terraform/OpenTofu State Model and Failure Modes

parts.title: Learn State-of-the-Art GitOps/IaC Pipeline - Part 009
parts.description: Production-grade IaC module system design: module boundaries, API contracts, versioning, provider handling, composition, migration, testing, policy compatibility, and failure modes.

parts.title: Learn State-of-the-Art GitOps/IaC Pipeline - Part 010
parts.description: Environment modeling without YAML hell: dimensions, hierarchy, overlays, promotion, stack boundaries, workspace risks, configuration contracts, and scalable environment topology.

parts.title: Learn State-of-the-Art GitOps/IaC Pipeline - Part 011
parts.description: Terragrunt and stack orchestration patterns for production GitOps/IaC platforms: units, DAGs, dependency outputs, run queues, orchestration boundaries, blast radius, and failure modeling.

parts.title: Learn State-of-the-Art GitOps/IaC Pipeline - Part 012
parts.description: Designing the IaC plan pipeline: diff classification, affected units, speculative plans, saved plans, plan JSON, policy gates, cost/risk summaries, approval binding, and evidence artifacts.

parts.title: Learn State-of-the-Art GitOps/IaC Pipeline - Part 013
parts.description: Designing the IaC apply pipeline as a controlled state transition system: approval binding, locking, execution identity, saved plans, re-planning, partial failure, retries, cancellation, evidence, rollback, and break-glass operation.

parts.title: Learn State-of-the-Art GitOps/IaC Pipeline - Part 014
parts.description: PR-driven IaC automation using Atlantis-style workflows: webhook architecture, plan/apply commands, autoplanning, locking, project configuration, security boundaries, policy gates, approvals, monorepo design, failure modes, and production rollout patterns.

parts.title: Learn State-of-the-Art GitOps/IaC Pipeline - Part 015
parts.description: Managed IaC runners and remote execution patterns for Terraform/OpenTofu, Pulumi, Crossplane-adjacent workflows, HCP Terraform-style remote runs, Spacelift/Scalr/env0-style orchestration, agent pools, isolation, run queues, network boundaries, policy hooks, artifacts, and production failure modes.
parts.partTitle: Managed IaC Runners and Remote Execution

parts.title: Learn State-of-the-Art GitOps/IaC Pipeline - Part 016
parts.description: Credentials, workload identity, OIDC federation, least-privilege role design, trust policies, short-lived credentials, human approval versus machine authorization, GitOps controller identities, break-glass access, auditability, and failure modes for production IaC pipelines.

parts.title: Learn State-of-the-Art GitOps/IaC Pipeline - Part 017
parts.description: Production-grade secrets management for GitOps and IaC pipelines: secret lifecycle, secret zero, SOPS, External Secrets Operator, Vault, cloud secret managers, Kubernetes Secrets, rotation, bootstrap, access control, auditability, and failure modes.

parts.title: Learn State-of-the-Art GitOps/IaC Pipeline - Part 018
parts.description: A production-grade foundation for policy as code in GitOps and IaC platforms: policy taxonomy, enforcement points, OPA/Rego, Sentinel, Conftest, Checkov, Kyverno, decision contracts, testing, rollout, exceptions, evidence, and failure modes.

parts.title: Learn State-of-the-Art GitOps/IaC Pipeline - Part 019
parts.description: Production-grade design of IaC policy gates before apply, covering plan JSON evaluation, policy input contracts, severity models, context enrichment, approvals, exceptions, destructive-change control, cost/security/compliance gates, evidence, rollout, testing, and failure modes.

parts.title: Learn State-of-the-Art GitOps/IaC Pipeline - Part 020
parts.description: Production-grade Kubernetes admission policy design for GitOps platforms, covering admission control mental models, Kyverno, OPA Gatekeeper, ValidatingAdmissionPolicy, pre-merge versus runtime enforcement, mutate/validate/generate policies, progressive rollout, policy exceptions, multi-tenancy, observability, failure modes, and operational runbooks.

parts.title: Learn State-of-the-Art GitOps/IaC Pipeline - Part 021
parts.description: Production-grade software supply chain security design for GitOps and IaC platforms, covering artifact integrity, SBOM, provenance, SLSA, in-toto attestations, registry trust, Terraform/OpenTofu provider and module supply chain, policy gates, evidence, and operational failure modes.

parts.title: Learn State-of-the-Art GitOps/IaC Pipeline - Part 022
parts.description: Deep implementation handbook for Sigstore, Cosign, keyless signing, Fulcio, Rekor, TUF roots, attestations, SLSA provenance, SBOM signing, identity-based verification, Kubernetes admission enforcement, and production rollout patterns in GitOps/IaC platforms.

parts.title: Learn State-of-the-Art GitOps/IaC Pipeline - Part 023
parts.description: Argo CD core model as a production reconciliation engine: Application, Project, sync, diff, health, app-of-apps, RBAC, multi-tenancy, failure modes, and operating rules.

parts.title: Learn State-of-the-Art GitOps/IaC Pipeline - Part 024
parts.description: Flux core model as a composable GitOps Toolkit: source-controller, kustomize-controller, helm-controller, notification-controller, image automation, dependency graph, multi-tenancy, and failure modes.

parts.title: Learn State-of-the-Art GitOps/IaC Pipeline - Part 025
parts.description: Decision framework untuk memilih Argo CD, Flux, atau kombinasi keduanya berdasarkan reconciliation model, tenancy, security, UX, scaling, extensibility, dan operating model production.
parts.partTitle: Argo CD vs Flux: Architecture Decision Framework

parts.title: Learn State-of-the-Art GitOps/IaC Pipeline - Part 026
parts.description: Production-grade configuration rendering untuk GitOps: Helm, Kustomize, Jsonnet, CUE, Carvel ytt, determinism, validation, diffability, ownership, dan failure model.
parts.partTitle: Configuration Rendering: Helm, Kustomize, Jsonnet, CUE, Carvel

parts.title: Learn State-of-the-Art GitOps/IaC Pipeline - Part 027
parts.description: Progressive delivery dalam GitOps: canary, blue-green, traffic shifting, metric analysis, automated rollback, safety gates, dan rollout state machine untuk production-grade systems.

parts.title: Learn State-of-the-Art GitOps/IaC Pipeline - Part 028
parts.description: Promotion dan release governance untuk GitOps/IaC: version promotion, environment ordering, change freeze, emergency path, approvals, evidence, rollback semantics, dan release operating model.

parts.title: Learn State-of-the-Art GitOps/IaC Pipeline - Part 029
parts.description: Drift detection and reconciliation for production-grade GitOps/IaC platforms, covering state planes, drift taxonomy, detection points, auto-heal strategy, drift budgets, exceptions, and recovery playbooks.

parts.title: Learn State-of-the-Art GitOps/IaC Pipeline - Part 030
parts.description: Observability design for production GitOps/IaC platforms, covering metrics, logs, traces, events, evidence, SLOs, dashboards, alerting, reconciliation lag, apply latency, policy denials, and operational analytics.

parts.title: Learn State-of-the-Art GitOps/IaC Pipeline - Part 031
parts.description: Failure modeling and recovery playbooks for production-grade GitOps and IaC pipelines, covering failed plans, failed applies, stuck locks, broken controllers, bad secrets, policy incidents, drift, and emergency recovery.

parts.title: Learn State-of-the-Art GitOps/IaC Pipeline - Part 032
parts.description: Rollback and rollforward engineering for GitOps and IaC systems, including app rollback, Git revert, infrastructure repair, database compatibility, policy rollback, controller rollback, and irreversible change design.

parts.title: Learn State-of-the-Art GitOps/IaC Pipeline - Part 033
parts.description: Database and stateful change engineering in GitOps, including schema migrations, expand-contract rollout, migration gating, backup/restore, Kafka/stateful resource evolution, and irreversible change governance.
parts.partTitle: Database and Stateful Change in GitOps

parts.title: Learn State-of-the-Art GitOps/IaC Pipeline - Part 034
parts.description: Multi-cluster, multi-account, and multi-region GitOps/IaC architecture for fleet management, landing zones, cluster bootstrap, tenancy isolation, promotion, blast-radius control, and failure recovery.

parts.title: Learn State-of-the-Art GitOps/IaC Pipeline - Part 035
parts.description: Designing platform APIs and self-service infrastructure as an internal product: service catalog, golden paths, scaffolding, request lifecycle, Git-backed workflows, policy, ownership, observability, and evidence.

parts.title: Learn State-of-the-Art GitOps/IaC Pipeline - Part 036
parts.description: Crossplane control-plane patterns for platform APIs, managed resources, composite resources, claims, compositions, providers, functions, GitOps integration, multi-tenancy, policy, status, drift, and failure recovery.

parts.title: Learn State-of-the-Art GitOps/IaC Pipeline - Part 037
parts.description: Safe usage of AI-assisted infrastructure-as-code, MCP-based documentation lookup, agent boundaries, threat modeling, review gates, policy enforcement, sandboxing, provenance, and hallucination-resistant workflows.

parts.title: Learn State-of-the-Art GitOps/IaC Pipeline - Part 038
parts.description: Compliance, audit, and evidence engineering for GitOps/IaC platforms, including control mapping, change evidence, approval records, immutable audit trails, segregation of duties, evidence schemas, and regulatory defensibility.

parts.title: Learn State-of-the-Art GitOps/IaC Pipeline - Part 039
parts.description: Production case study for building an enterprise GitOps/IaC platform from repository model to plan, policy, approval, apply, reconciliation, observability, audit evidence, and operating runbooks.
parts.partTitle: Production Case Study: Enterprise GitOps/IaC Platform

parts.title: Learn State-of-the-Art GitOps/IaC Pipeline - Part 040
parts.description: Final operating handbook, maturity model, review checklist, anti-pattern catalog, runbook index, architecture review prompts, and mastery path for state-of-the-art GitOps/IaC pipeline engineering.
parts.partTitle: Final Operating Handbook and Mastery Checklist
